sentence_stem: Although many people prefer online shopping,
correct_completion: small shops still have an important role in our communities.
full_sentence: Although many people prefer online shopping, small shops still have an important role in our communities.
acceptable_variants: local shops still matter to many communities.
traditional markets continue to attract many customers.

options.text: so they never visit shops in person.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, but 'although' requires a contrast with the first clause, not a consequence of it.

options.text: they often buy things on the internet.
options.why_wrong: This repeats the idea of the first clause instead of contrasting with it.

options.text: small shops still have an important role in our communities.
the internet was invented in the 1990s.
options.why_wrong: This is a historical fact, but it does not contrast with the preference stated in the first clause.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a contrast with the idea in the first clause. Polish speakers often reach for a cause-effect link with a word like 'so' here, but the concessive structure requires an unexpected or opposing outcome.
translation: Chociaż wielu ludzi woli zakupy online, małe sklepy nadal odgrywają ważną rolę w naszych społecznościach.
